scenario: LUNI.8.7.2 — `::Float` strips the unit dimension from a unit-typed value, returning the underlying base-unit float as a unitless Float (runtime identity; compile-time dim drop). Pin: `(r.w::Float) * (r.h::Float)` compiles cleanly (the LUNI.8.4 dim*dim check sees no dim tags after stripping).
rules_ds:
schema Rect scope logical:
    w: meter key
    h: meter mutable

rule big:
    Rect r where (r.w::Float * r.h::Float) > 10
->
    log info "big rect via float strip"
